prompt.es: ¿Qué respuesta de empresa es más formal y precisa?

choices.text: We will investigate the delay and respond within three days.
We will look into the delay and get back to you in three days.
Leave the delay with us; we will sort it out in three days.

feedback.es: Investigate y respond son los verbos formales; las otras opciones usan phrasal verbs (look into, get back to, sort out) y suenan más cercanas.

prompt.es: Escucha esta reclamación y elige el diagnóstico de su tono.

choices.text: Stiff: too official for the situation.
Blunt: an order with no polite markers.
Warm: friendly and polite.

feedback.es: Dos órdenes secas y sin cortesía forman un mensaje brusco; habría que suavizarlo.

origin.audio: Give me my money back now. I will not wait.

prompt.es: Escribe la reclamación formal con hechos, tu reacción, una petición concreta y un plazo.

answer.text: Dear Sir or Madam, I am writing to complain about the oven I bought on 3 March. The delivery arrived two weeks late, and the oven is faulty. I was disappointed, because we needed it for a family dinner on Saturday. This delay is unacceptable, and I expect you to resolve it. I would therefore be grateful if you could arrange a replacement or a full refund by Friday. Please tell me what you will do about the delay. I look forward to your reply. Kind regards, Carlos Ruiz
accepted: Dear Sir or Madam, I am writing to complain about the oven I bought on 3 March. The delivery arrived two weeks late, and the oven is faulty. I was disappointed, because we needed it for a family dinner on Saturday. This delay is unacceptable, and I expect you to resolve it. I would therefore be grateful if you could arrange a replacement or a full refund by Friday. Please tell me what you will do about the delay. I look forward to your reply. Kind regards, Carlos Ruiz

Dear Sir or Madam, I am writing regarding the oven I bought on 3 March. It arrived two weeks late, and it is broken. I am disappointed, because we wanted to use it for a family dinner. Such a delay is unacceptable. I would be grateful if you could send a replacement or refund the full price by Friday. Kind regards, Carlos Ruiz

feedback.es: La reclamación ordena motivo, hechos, reacción, petición y plazo, en un registro formal sostenido.

origin.text: Compraste un horno el 3 de marzo. Llegó con dos semanas de retraso y está defectuoso. Tenías una cena familiar el sábado y te sentiste decepcionado. El retraso es inaceptable. Pide un horno nuevo o el reembolso completo antes del viernes. Tono formal y firme, con saludo y despedida.
